sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our offer stands at a price of €137.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

In the interest of our long-standing relationship, we can reduce our price to €136.20, and we ask you to share the analysis that led to your figure. To keep the price as favorable as possible for you, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms rather than extending to 60 days.

As an alternative at our standard terms, we can offer a price of €136.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €136.20 per unit.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your request for 90-day payment terms, but extending payment terms increases our financing costs. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. To accommodate this request, we can offer a price of €138.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. 

Alternatively, our previous offers remain open, and we still await the data behind your analysis. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body: Thank you for your offer. Based on our analysis we can offer the terms below.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to stay in touch with our valued partners at Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, given the long relationship our companies have shared over the years. We have reviewed your offer thoroughly and hold our Angebot. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. As we have requested multiple times, please provide the data and analysis that lead to your figures. Without this transparency, we must hold our offer at €138.40 for 90-day payment terms. 

To be fully clear, our current Angebot stands at a price of €138.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, and is valid from 1 November 2026. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to continuing our trustful partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to do business with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, given our long relationship and history together. We note your slightly improved offer, but we are still missing the data behind your analysis. Please provide the basis for your figures so we can have a meaningful discussion. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

To show our willingness to reach an agreement, we can reduce our price to €138.00 for 90-day payment terms. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €138.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
